sloka: मम भक्षः प्रदिष्टस्त्वमीश्वरैर्वानरर्षभ ।अहं त्वा भक्षयिष्यामि प्रविशेदं ममाननम् ॥५-१-१५१॥
transliteration: mama bhakṣaḥ pradiṣṭastvamīśvarairvānararṣabha ।ahaṁ tvā bhakṣayiṣyāmi praviśedaṁ mamānanam ॥5-1-151॥

translations.english: "O bull among vanaras the lords of the universe have provided you as food for me. I will eat you. Enter my mouth".
